INTRO DATE
ORDINANCE (Q)CTORER 22,2024

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single Detached Housing District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 80-B in the area bounded by:

West Potomac Avenue; North Laramie Avenue; the Public Alley next south of and parallel to
West Potomac Avenue; and a line 125 feet west of and parallel to North Laramie Avenue

To those of a BI-1 Neighborhood Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 5213 W. Potomac Ave., Chicago, IL 60651
